Vita Nova es una organización social sin: Vita Nova is a non-profit social organization based in Medellín, founded by people with disabilities. We don't come to communities from the outside: we are part of them. We work with people with disabilities, indigenous communities and vulnerable populations, and also with their families and caregivers.
En los territorios donde trabajamos coin: In the territories where we work, structural poverty, food insecurity and an unprotected ecosystem converge. On top of that, disability adds physical, communication and attitudinal barriers that leave people out of the education system, the labour market and, often, community life.
Nuestra misión es restituir de manera in: Our mission is to fully restore those rights through emotional support, education with reasonable accommodations, accessible technology and solidarity-economy production units. Our vision is a national network of autonomous, productive communities where inclusion stops being a program and becomes the very structure of the local economy.
Trabajamos sin financiación estatal. Nos: We work without state funding. We are sustained by self-management, alliances with companies, corporate social responsibility and international cooperation. Our motto sums it up:
Integración sin etiquetas. Todos somos p: Integration without labels. We are all people with full dignity.
